profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Bluefin
profile.summary: Whole-stack Rust engineer. 10+ years of UI, infrastructure, and everything between. Specializing in performance under hard runtime constraints. Trunk-based native.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
The first hire at this early-stage startup, owning architecture and product decisions alongside the founders - from securing the K8s cluster and writing database migrations to writing the Rust simulation core and building responsive UIs with React.

The Bluefin platform simulates clinical trials in near realtime using a digital-twin model rather than Monte Carlo: enrollment, dosing, supply chain, and supply acquisition across thousands of patients and hundreds of sites, a problem recursive in nature since supply and demand drive each other.

The Rust engine runs entirely in the browser on average business laptops - via WASM, on a single core, in under 200MiB of memory - hitting sub-second latency with a 200ms target, in an industry where competitors rely on on-prem server fleets to scale.

Worked the platform through SOC 2 Type II compliance with multi-region, highly-available infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes. Currently driving an independent mirror of the AWS production infrastructure into Azure. The platform is in production use by two of the world's 50 largest pharmaceutical companies.

Currently directs open-weight coding agents on custom harnesses for most implementation, focusing on architecture, product, and the problems agents can't solve.
positions.insights: Skills: Rust (Programming Language) · Tailwind CSS · Node.js · React · Pulumi · PostgreSQL · Vite · Express.js · DevOps · Prisma ORM · TypeScript · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Founding Engineer, Co-Owner
positions.description: Co-founded a consultancy for bespoke software development, delivering for two clients while incubating internal products. Built the backend of a distributed health-checking platform - benchmarked at 10,000 checks per second across a highly-available cluster, tolerant of node loss, with satellite nodes joining dynamically, on $28/month of core infrastructure (Orleans on Flatcar Linux + K8s). Independent work includes managing a 70-server fleet spanning three physical sites, operated to enterprise HA standards. Broader experience spans fault-tolerant distributed computing and layer-3 performance across high-latency WAN links.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Hired to improve engineering-wide processes by applying DevOps philosophies. Completed a full-stack development effort comprising multiple databases and networks across 5 microservices - the first public-facing product from GMR: mobile friendliness, custom data visualizations, interactive diagrams, customer notifications, an administration portal, and a search engine with a custom search grammar. Completed 8 months ahead of schedule, targeting an average response time under 20ms.

positions.description: Hired to improve the process problems plaguing the engineering department. positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, .NET Agent Security Team
positions.description:
Built and maintained the .NET Contrast Agent - deep runtime work: IL manipulation and generation, hot-path analysis optimizing for low-latency GC, CLR and CoreCLR internals across .NET Framework (3.5-4.8) and .NET (Core 2.1-3.1, 6, 7), and reverse engineering of .NET assemblies for vulnerability evaluation and IL hooks.

Architected and helped implement automatic injection of .NET/Java/NodeJS/PHP agents into existing Kubernetes workloads with a Kubernetes operator. The operator was designed to operate in large Kubernetes clusters of over 10,000 pods through the use of techniques such as back pressure control, event stream compression, etc. The Kubernetes operator is now [Open Source](https://github.com/Contrast-Security-OSS/agent-operator).

Architected and implemented a telemetry aggregation and error reporting service cluster. The entirety of this service was designed, implemented, and deployed by the .NET agent team - including concerns such as high availability, horizontal scaling, infrastructure security, abuse detection and mitigation, time series based reporting, etc.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Joined as a software engineer, promoted to software architect. Built the .NET abstraction over the 3270 mainframe protocol from IBM documentation - powering both AxxessBlackScreen, a modern web emulator for the 3270 terminal, and the Medicare DDE scraping system. Scaled that scraper - built to survive Medicare's monthly breaking changes - to over 1 million managed patients, until a formal letter from Medicare mandated a throttle after our traffic visibly slowed the DDE mainframe on weekday mornings.

Led the team to trunk-based development and daily releases as an early adopter: the highest feature output and fastest defect-to-resolution time in the organization, and the only team running without QA - later the organization's engineering template.

Pioneered engineering telemetry, CI/CD, and testing practices. Architected the single sign-on (SSO) system on OpenID Connect (OIDC) servicing all products and mobile applications.

Modernized on-prem infrastructure: Hyper-V for density, Consul with deployment-integrated service discovery, and Windows Docker container experiments. Owned the ELK log cluster for all teams, ingesting 10 billion documents per month, with the JVM GC tuning that required.
